messages:
rachel: quick tie-up from today's postmortem. we've got 3 leftover remediation actions that keep getting punted. let's name owners + backups + set ETAs before EOD.

omar: can you list the items?

rachel: sure: 1) eviction hysteresis tuning for multi-tenant prefix cache (recurs every couple weeks) 2) emergency rollback dry-run + toggle (we lack rehearsal) 3) remediation tracker hygiene: ensure tickets have recurrence notes + cross-team blockers.

lucy: I'll own (1) eviction hysteresis. will run focused traces and propose a hysteresis window. filing INF-4307. ETA spike & PR by 2026-04-09.

infra-bot: Created INF-4307 (Eviction hysteresis tuning) and assigned to lucy.

ben: I can pick up (2) rollback dry-run. need runtime pairing and a QA slot. opening INF-4308. ETA dry-run by 2026-04-08.

infra-bot: Created INF-4308 (Canary rollback dry-run + toggle) and assigned to ben.

marta: I'll handle (3) tracker hygiene + recurrence tagging. will sweep the board and add short timelines to each ticket. creating INF-4309. ETA done by 2026-04-03.

infra-bot: Created INF-4309 (Remediation tracker hygiene) and assigned to marta.

lucy: proposed RACI: INF-4307 R=lucy A=rachel C=eng-runtime/eng-sre I=oncall.

ben: INF-4308 R=ben A=rachel C=qa/runtime I=customers.

marta: INF-4309 R=marta A=program-lead C=triage-team I=stakeholders.

omar: backups?

lucy: backup for 4307 = omar.

ben: backup for 4308 = lucy.

marta: backup for 4309 = rachel.

rachel: recurrence note: eviction-related latency burst happened 3x in last 7 weeks across dedicated and private clusters. tag tickets with "recurrence: eviction-burst" and paste the short incident timeline.

lucy: adding traces + load-profile to INF-4307 (timestamps included). will paste a short reproduce script.

ben: will attach the rollback checklist and a dry-run playbook to INF-4308 and request a QA window Mon 10:00-11:30.

marta: I'll add short timelines to INF-4307/4308 and confirm tracker links. also will update the remediation board sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REM-REMEDIATION.

infra-bot: INF-4307, INF-4308, INF-4309 linked to PM-2026-03-29 and added to remediation board.

rachel: admin asks: 1) set JIRA "remediation ETA" field 2) link PRs to the PM doc 3) flag cross-team blockers by Thu so I can escalate. reply here once done.

lucy: INF-4307 ETA 2026-04-09. PR link posted.

ben: INF-4308 ETA 2026-04-08. booked QA Mon 10:00-11:30 and linked playbook.

marta: INF-4309 ETA 2026-04-03. tracker sweep complete, recurrence tags added.

omar: scheduling: propose 15-min sync Fri 09:15 to confirm progress and unblock any vendor/platform deps. ok?

rachel: yes please add to calendar. final: owners set the JIRA "remediation owner" and "backup" fields and ping here. i'll leave thread open until all three show In Progress on the remediation board. will escalate Friday if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
